title: Clinical Characteristics of Cholinergic Urticaria in Korea
author: Kim et al.
passage: A clinical cohort describes cholinergic urticaria associated with increases in body temperature and triggers such as exercise. Trigger patterns help characterize the condition; they do not establish a diagnosis from a text description.

title: Taurine chloramine selectively regulates neutrophil degranulation
author: Kim et al.
passage: This experimental study investigated taurine chloramine and neutrophil degranulation, including myeloperoxidase and lactoferrin. A derivative acting in cells is not evidence that oral taurine treats heat-triggered hives.

title: Taurine chloramine and macrophage inflammatory mediators
author: Marcinkiewicz et al.
passage: Taurine chloramine reduced production of certain inflammatory mediators in vitro. These findings do not demonstrate a clinical effect of taurine supplementation or establish the cause of an individual response.

title: Autonomic systems
author: Ray Peat
passage: Peat frames cells and nervous systems as adaptive systems responsive to their environment. His broader account links nervous excitation, metabolism and signaling substances; this is an interpretive framework, not clinical confirmation of a symptom explanation.
